description: This Java source file defines the 'AttributesNotModifiableException' class, a custom runtime exception indicating that attributes of a 'Thing' cannot be modified due to insufficient permissions. It includes builder methods, JSON parsing capabilities, and integrates with the Ditto framework's exception hierarchy.

classes.name: AttributesNotModifiableException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception thrown when attributes of a 'Thing' are not modifiable due to permission issues. Extends 'DittoRuntimeException' and implements 'ThingException'. Includes static factory methods and an inner builder class.

classes.name: AttributesNotModifiableException.Builder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class for constructing instances of 'AttributesNotModifiableException' with a fluent API, allowing customization of message, description, cause, and href.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new builder instance initialized with the provided 'ThingId'.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Constructs an 'AttributesNotModifiableException' from a custom message and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an 'AttributesNotModifiableException' by parsing a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with the specified Ditto headers, retaining other properties.
